title: August and the Alibi
author: Beatrix Blackwood
blurb: August Whitlock, a true-crime podcaster chasing the coldest case on record, has quietly solved three deaths the police called accidents. Then twin letters arrive: one confessing, one promising more — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must trap a killer who knows the case file better than the investigators do, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
